The licensing system in Maharashtra divides PSARA licenses into different categories based on operational range and organizational dimensions.
State-Level PSARA License

The state-level PSARA license enables security companies to conduct their operations throughout the whole state of Maharashtra. This option works best for agencies that want to serve major corporate customers and handle infrastructure development work and manage operations in various cities.
District-Level PSARA License

The district-level PSARA license permits organizations to conduct their business operations only within one designated district. This option serves small and medium-sized agencies that want to concentrate on serving their nearby customers.
Multi-State Operations

All agencies that function in several states need to secure individual PSARA licenses for each state they operate within. The PSARA license operates within Maharashtra borders only, while all other states remain inaccessible.
